hints: Suppose you had to pick exactly one reading from each series. What are the range's two ends, and which of them is easy to keep track of?
The smallest and the largest of the chosen readings. The largest is easy - it only ever goes up as you advance - and the smallest is the one that has to move.
Keep one reading from each series in a min-heap and remember the largest of them separately. The current range is [heap root, that largest].
To narrow it, advance the series that owns the smallest reading - nothing else can help. Stop when that series runs out, because from then on no range covers everything.
